description: This file defines a template class MessageDataBufferType within the WPEFramework::Messaging namespace. It manages inter-process communication buffers, including a nested DataBuffer class that handles cyclic buffers with doorbell signaling for synchronization. The class provides methods for pushing and popping data, waiting for signals, and managing buffer files, with configuration based on filenames and socket ports.

classes.name: MessageDataBufferType
classes.description: A template class managing message buffers with synchronization via doorbells, supporting data push/pop, waiting, and buffer file management.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: A nested class within MessageDataBufferType that extends Core::CyclicBuffer to handle data buffering with doorbell signaling, including methods for signaling, waiting, and buffer management.

methods.name: PrepareFilenames
methods.description: Static method to generate filenames for buffer files based on directory, identifier, instance ID, and socket port.

methods.name: PushData
methods.description: Method to write data into the cyclic buffer and notify the other process via doorbell.

methods.name: PopData
methods.description: Method to read data from the cyclic buffer after a doorbell signal, handling partial messages and errors.

methods.name: Ring
methods.description: Method to signal data availability via the doorbell.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Method to wait for a doorbell signal within a specified timeout.

methods.name: FlushDataBuffer
methods.description: Method to flush the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Check if the cyclic buffer is valid.

methods.name: MetadataName
methods.description: Retrieve the metadata filename associated with the buffer.
